janesabha.p: [Jana+vasabha¿] (pu) CL=8 male deity named Janavasabha.
pn:
Janesabha. A Gandhabba, a vassal of the Four Regent Gods. He was present at the preaching of the Mahā Samaya (DN.ii.258).

In the Āṭānāṭiyasutta (DN.iii.204) he is mentioned as a Yakkha chieftain to be invoked by the Buddha’s followers in time of need.

He is probably identical with Janavasabha.
